The right intent is to keep this candidate as a survivor and run another local round focused on diversity and liability reduction rather than treating the current presence of a top-ranked candidate as terminal.

plan.goal: Generate, evaluate, QC, and rank a single compact de novo soluble protein candidate.
assumptions: A short unconditional monomer backbone is an acceptable proxy for a small soluble de novo design target.
One designed backbone and one inverse-folded sequence are sufficient for this compact workflow.
Structure evidence can be obtained from sequence-to-structure prediction without external templates or MSA support for a de novo sequence.
